name: Coconut worm
summary: The national rural article names đuông dừa fried in butter on the Cồn Phụng lunch, beside the other garden plates. Nothing beyond the butter was printed. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Cồn Phụng, on the national rural lunch list.
howToEat: Order it at the islet lunch. The rural article prints it fried in butter. No further recipe was printed.
A stall price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: The garden table at Cồn Phụng.
seoTitle: Coconut worm in Ben Tre — fried in butter
